# PayProbe

**Source-available integration testing & simulation framework for distributed backend systems**

[![License: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-PolyForm_Noncommercial_1.0.0-orange.svg)](https://github.com/pay-probe/payprobe/blob/main/LICENSE)
[![GitHub Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/pay-probe/payprobe?style=social)](https://github.com/pay-probe/payprobe)

Automated three-phase regression testing and protocol simulation across multi-service backend stacks — edge clients, application servers, crypto/HSM, databases, and message switches.

**50,000 concurrent connections · 10,000 operations/sec · Angular portal · Docker-native**
